Explore this repository and propose the content of the (FILL IN) sections of `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

Find out by looking at the real code, without inventing:
- Stack and versions (package.json, configs), and whether React Compiler is used
- Folder structure and where features, components, hooks, services live
- Repeating patterns (names, component style, how APIs are called, state management)
- How the design system is used and which components exist
- How tests are written (RTL, Playwright) and where they live; the exact test command and whether it is watch mode
- Build, lint, typecheck and test commands

Deliver text ready to paste into the instructions and a list of "inconsistencies I found" (places where the project does not follow its own pattern).
Do not edit any file; only propose. Answer in Brazilian Portuguese.
